market_name: Detroit–Ann Arbor, Michigan visitor market (PetTripFinder discovery scope)

geographic_bounds._disclosure: A loose enclosing box spanning the Detroit metro core, Oakland County suburbs, DTW airport, and the Ann Arbor / Washtenaw core, not an authoritative MSA boundary. Two distinct travel cores (Detroit and Ann Arbor) share this one box.

coordinate_precision_disclosure: All lat/lng values in this file are low-precision (~2 decimal places, roughly 1km) approximate municipal-center reference points from general public geographic knowledge, rounded deliberately to avoid a false impression of survey-grade precision. They are seed points for bounded-radius provider queries only.

cells.label: Ann Arbor (core + campus + Research Park/State St)

scope_disclosure: 11 cells matching the committed ptf-market/1.1 corridors. Ann Arbor core and Ann Arbor south/Research Park were tested as separate hypothesis corridors (per the work order's boundary hypotheses) but could not be independently split without fabricating ZIP-level data no discovery source actually stated, so they are collapsed into one ann-arbor corridor pending ZIP-level identity recovery. Conservative seed points for later provider queries. Not a complete parcel-level boundary.
